changes: Product relationship reads the whole artwork including in-image copy; only copy outside the artwork is excluded
Prototype stage hard-stops only verifiable reversal or compliance conflicts; subjective relation judgments are hints
Direction divergence explores substantively different visual methods via the style entry table and self-checks single-material sets; no quotas or bans
A4 handback choices (change direction / revise action / continue) all have valid paths; first poster of a series passes production-candidate checks
Product posture and perspective are planned from action and camera before generation; label check requires recognizable correct text, not a frontal label
Version carryover always cites the original user choice, with actionable errors for repeated upgrades
legacy_regressions: No rule or historical contract changed beyond the two fixes
limits: Real trial: two approved print works under candidate rules; other changes verified by zero-generation calibration and synthetic full-chain regression
Independent review can still miss pasted-on looks and dark-on-dark text; the user remains the final judge
Automatic checks are model judgments, not human approval
promotion_basis: Verified candidate runtime with documented distribution cleanup; publication only after explicit user authorization.
